name: Klimmuur Centraal
description: Klimmuur Centraal is the climbing hall on Dijksgracht beside Oosterdok. Its sharply sloping shell contains a hall over 16 metres tall. A folding steel-and-glass climbing wall connects the climbing activity with the waterfront terrace.
funFact: The waterfront glass wall is itself climbable: its four folding elements carry holds and can slide aside. The architect used electromagnets to secure the doors while people climb.
